{{Quote|As I explained to you earlier, I am quite convinced that 10,000 more systems will rally to our cause with your support, gentlemen.|Dooku addresses Rogwa Wodrata and the other Separatists|audio=Dooku-Rally-AOTC.flac|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
'''Rogwa Wodrata''' was an important<ref name="OF84" /> [[Holwuff]]<ref name="AOTC" /> [[senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] who supported the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="OF84" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], including Rogwa Wodrata's appearance, to [[22 BBY]].</ref> Wodrata attended a [[Geonosian accord|summit]] in the [[Stalgasin hive]] on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]] in which the members of the [[Executive Separatist Council]] pledged their allegiance to [[Count]] [[Dooku]], the head of the Confederacy. Shortly after the summit ended, the [[First Battle of Geonosis]] broke out between the Separatists and the Republic, beginning the [[Clone Wars]]. Wodrata had [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s, brown skin, and [[hair]]. While on Geonosis, the senator wore a black [[Clothing|robe]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rogwa Wodrata first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" /> Originally, the character [[Toonbuck Toora]] appeared in the summit scene on Geonosis,<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> portrayed by [[Hilton Howson]],<ref name="Aveleyman">{{WebCite|url=https://www.aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=76971|text=Aveleyman – Hilton Howson|work=[http://www.aveleyman.com Aveleyman.com]|archivedate=20181105143534}}</ref> one of the film's creature artists.<ref name="AOTC" /> However, director [[George Lucas]] was not satisfied by the Toora costume's lack of expression and menace. He had the character replaced in post production with the more fearsome looking Wodrata, who was created by retooling an [[alien]] [[Jedi]] head and compositing it over Toora's face.<ref name="Chronicles" /> The production staff nicknamed the character "Gator Head."<ref name="Insider65">{{InsiderCite|65|Ask Lobot}}</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Wodrata was identified in<ref name="OF84" /> the [[December 16]], [[2016]]<ref name="MagDate">{{WebCite|url=https://jedi-bibliothek.de/2016/12/panini-2017-offizielles-star-wars-magazin|text=The ''Official Star Wars Magazine'' will move to Panini in 2017|work=Jedi-Bibliothek.de|archivedate=20230205045735}}</ref> [[Star Wars - Das offizielle Magazin 84|eighty-fourth issue]] of [[Star Wars - Das offizielle Magazin|''Star Wars - The Official Magazine'']].<ref name="OF84" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in the "[[Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A]]" section of the [[Star Wars Insider 65|sixty-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="Insider65" /> and published on [[January 21]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20021219.html|text=''Insider'' #65 & ''Bantha Tracks'' #2}}</ref>
